chunks.text: EV Battery & Charger Components – Vibes Components . . Skip to content . . . . EV Battery & Charger Components. . . . . . . . EV Battery & Charger Components . . . . Our seals and gaskets for electric vehicles (EVs) are specifically designed to enhance the performance and reliability of critical systems in modern electric drivetrains. Manufactured from high-quality, durable materials such as silicone and EPDM, these seals and gaskets provide exceptional resistance to temperature fluctuations, chemical exposure, and environmental factors. In EV applications, our seals effectively prevent the ingress of moisture, dust, and contaminants, ensuring optimal performance in battery enclosures, cooling systems, and electrical connectors. Designed with precision, they maintain tight tolerances to minimize leaks, enhance energy efficiency, and provide IP67 protection, crucial for maximizing vehicle range and safety. Additionally, our solutions offer protection from thermal runaway and are compliant with automotive industry standards. . . . . . Our product range includes metal to rubber bonded components, TPE and TPU components with adhesive tape, and indigenous compounds replacing imported materials, ensuring tailored solutions for specific applications. We focus on thermal conduction, flame retardancy, and maintaining volume and surface resistivity.

Wire Seals, Connector Seals & Mat Seals . . . . Our wire and connector seals are meticulously engineered to provide unparalleled protection for electrical connections across various applications. Manufactured from advanced formulated compounds like silicone and NBR, our seals ensure durability and reliability in even the most demanding environments.. . . . . . Silicone Seals . . . . Crafted from both oil-bleeding and non-oil-bleeding HCR and LSR, our silicone seals offer remarkable resistance to temperature extremes, UV radiation, and chemical exposure. Their robust design, featuring ribbed or flared profiles, guarantees a secure fit around wire terminations, effectively blocking moisture, dust, and contaminants. By utilizing compression technology, our wire seals form a tight barrier upon installation, enhancing the longevity of electrical systems.. . . . . . . . . . . . Customizable Solutions . . . . Available in a variety of sizes and configurations to accommodate different wire gauges, our seals are validated to SAE USCAR 2 Standards. They are dust-tight and protected against temporary immersion in water, making them ideal for waterproof connectors and other critical applications.. . . . . . Compatibility and Efficiency . . . .

We specialize in the development of custom elastomer compounds, specifically engineered to meet the unique requirements of your in-house applications. Our experienced team collaborates closely with you to design and formulate high-performance materials, ensuring exceptional properties such as durability, flexibility, and resistance to wear, heat, and chemicals. Through a comprehensive validation process, we rigorously test and refine each compound, utilizing advanced testing methods to uphold the highest industry standards. These compounds are meticulously crafted to perform reliably under demanding conditions, offering tailored, sustainable solutions exclusively for internal use and not for commercial sale.. . . . . . Compound Development & Validations . . . . . . Flame -retardant Elastomers for EV Battery Safety . . . . To address the challenge of preventing repetitive thermal runaways in electric vehicles (EVs), battery manufacturers sought flame-retardant elastomers that also offered excellent electrical and mechanical properties. Traditionally, these specialized elastomers were expensive and imported, creating a supply chain and cost challenge..
